success.stdout: One original immutable payload, exact bytes including its existing final newline/spacing; no JSON wrapper or additional newline.
success.stderr: empty in validated successful process tests

refusal.stdout: Diagnostic text only; consumer must reject every nonzero exit.
conditions: duplicate selector or required input value
wrong package, commit, tree or rights pin
unrelated corrupt material or invalid full package membership
grant, output or other nonselected options

compatibility.without_selector: Original text summary; --json gives byte-identical original JSON summary.
compatibility.global_help: Existing --help/-h short-circuit remains; returns help, never evidence. Consumer should use the exact normal invocation without help.
compatibility.global_root: Existing global --root parsing unchanged; relative file resolves under it.
compatibility.existing_main_guard: Compiled/runtime declaration disagreement can independently exit3 before command execution.

consumer_acceptance: Check process exit, exact expected length, independent SHA256 and equality to retained original bytes before calling a readback equivalent. Do not infer current rights/authority/acceptance from payload contents.
scope: SOURCE_ONLY byte readback. accepted0,enrollment0,authorityfalse,NO_GRANT,cutoverfalse,retirementfalse,all6OPEN,nulltargetcustody/Host/currentrights. Native Pump/wire/FD17 limits unchanged; raw CLI output is not native runtime admission.
library: Existing SelectedPackage::evidence_bytes(path) API remains unchanged; CLI copies that original validated array only after full read_bound.
verification: Explicitly executed apps/cli/tests/ecdev_selected_readback.rs authentic-package process tests; final logs and binary identity are in commands.json/transport.json.
publication: Resolve this contract and transport.json at the same containing main Git commit; exact postpush verification is recorded outside the immutable commit.
